title: Imperfetto
rule: Infinitive minus -re + -vo, -vi, -va, -vamo, -vate, -vano. Essere: ero, eri, era, eravamo, eravate, erano. Old stems: facevo, dicevo, bevevo, traducevo, ponevo, traevo. Uses: habits and repeated actions, descriptions, age, time, dates and weather, states of mind, actions in progress as background, and the polite request (volevo un caffè). English renders it with used to, would, was doing or a plain past.

blocks.caption: Uses
head: Use
Italian
English
rows: habit, repeated action
Andavo a scuola a piedi. Ogni estate venivamo qui.
I used to walk to school. Every summer we came here.
description of people, places, things
Nonno era alto. Il porto era piccolo. Le barche erano di legno.
Grandpa was tall. The port was small. The boats were wooden.
age
Avevo undici anni.
I was eleven.
time, date, weather
Erano le tre. Era il 12 aprile. Pioveva. Faceva freddo.
It was three. It was 12 April. It was raining. It was cold.
state of mind, knowledge, wish
Volevo restare. Sapevo tutto. Non capivo niente. Avevo paura.
I wanted to stay. I knew everything. I understood nothing. I was afraid.
action in progress (background)
Dormiva quando è partito il treno.
He was sleeping when the train left.
two parallel actions
Mentre nonna cucinava, nonno raccontava.
While nonna cooked, grandpa told stories.
polite request (present meaning)
Volevo un caffè. Cercavo un locale. Volevo chiederle una cosa.
I'd like a coffee. I'm looking for premises. I wanted to ask you something.
impersonal si
Si partiva e basta. Si beveva l'acqua del pozzo.
People left, and that was it. People drank water from the well.

items.t: Quando ero piccolo, la televisione era al bar e si guardava tutti insieme.
items.n: When I was little, the television was at the bar and everybody watched it together.

items.t: Faceva caldo, erano le due e non c'era nessuno in strada.
items.n: It was hot, it was two o'clock and there was nobody in the street.

items.t: Mio nonno non parlava mai del viaggio; mia nonna ne parlava sempre.
items.n: My grandfather never talked about the journey; my grandmother always talked about it.

items.t: Scusi, cercavo la farmacia. — È qui dietro.
items.n: Excuse me, I'm looking for the pharmacy. — It's just behind here.

items.wrong: Ho avuto dieci anni. Ha fatto freddo quel giorno. (as background)
items.right: Avevo dieci anni. Faceva freddo quel giorno.
items.why: Age and weather as scenery: imperfetto.

items.wrong: Usavo andare. Ero solito andare. (possible but bookish)
items.why: The imperfetto alone means used to.
Stress on the stem in loro.

items.q: Da bambina Dora ___ (abitare) in campagna, ___ (aiutare) la madre e non ___ (avere) giochi. La domenica tutti ___ (andare) in chiesa e poi ___ (esserci) il pranzo.
items.n: As a child Dora lived in the country, helped her mother and had no toys. On Sundays everyone went to church and then there was lunch.

items.q: It was cold, it was six o'clock and the bar was still closed.
answers: Faceva freddo, erano le sei e il bar era ancora chiuso
